notes.title: Update Patch 0.7.0.
notes.content:
Hey Cafe Owners! 👋
 Beta 0.7.0 is here — and it's our last update for the DEMO! Let’s check out what’s brewing:
[hr][/hr]
Patch Notes – Beta 0.7.0 ☕

New Features:

    🔼 Added a Move Button to the Farm — rearrange with ease!
    📬 You can now Visit Friends through Postal Services.
    🎩 Added Color Customization for Hats.
    👀 Added Eye Color Customization.
    🧑‍🌾 Introduced Farming Management — assign specific jobs to your Farmers.
    🥘 Added "Not Serving" as a new Sorting Option in the Recipe Menu.
    🌱 Farm Popup now appears automatically when you hover over it.
    🏃‍♂️ Staff Members now move faster!
    🎵 Clicking on Jukeboxes now opens the Radio Menu.


For Streamers:

    📢 Streamer Bot and StreamElements are now officially supported!
    🔄 The Streaming Command UI can now manually switch pages.

[hr][/hr]
🔈 If you run into any issues, feel free to contact us or post on our Steam Community

notes.title: Patch Update 0.6.10.

notes.title: Update Patch 0.6.8.

New Additions:

    📘 Added Recipe Count to the top of the Recipe Menu — track how many dishes you’re still missing!

notes.title: Update Patch 0.6.6.
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596552/1fe4e389566e9abf7b3b6cff7e4d23bf764604f8.png
Attention all cafe owner
We've updated the game to Beta 0.6.6. 
[hr][/hr]
What We Have Fixed & Added

 Flipping Tool: You can now flip kitchen appliances and decorations!
 Link postal service feature to Steam ID. This will reset all your previous contact list and email.
 Part-Timer Postal Service: Send part-timers to work at your friends’ cafés. 
 Quest Rewards: Completing quests now earns you money. 
 Kitchen Staff Optimization: More efficient kitchen operations. 
 New Carpets: Added horizontal and vertical striped grass-type carpets. 
 Starter Money Boost: Increased from 2,000 to 10,000 upon tutorial completion. 
 Quest UI Upgrade: Improved appearance for better readability. 
 Water Creature Production: All water creatures now yield 2 products—except pearl oysters. 
 Recruitment Skin Tone Update: New recruits start with a standard skin tone (you can still change them to green or blue!). 
 Recipe Ingredient Font: Increased text size for better clarity. 
 Pomodoro Function Update: Timer now starts automatically when work/rest periods end. 
 Pomodoro & Timer Display: Visible on top of tip jars when running, even after closing the menu. 
 Pomodoro Customization: Adjust alert sounds and volume settings. 
 Ingredient Info: View growing durations when hovering over ingredients in recipes. 
 UI Fix: Left-side UI adjustments. 
 Recipe Fix: Resolved missing recipe bug. 
 Minor Bug Fixes: Addressed various minor issues. 

[hr][/hr]
📢 If you run into any issues, feel free to contact us or post on our Steam Community

notes.title: Update note Beta 0.5.0 The Starry Night Update
notes.content:
We've updated the game to Beta 0.5.0. 

The Starry Night Update 

 New Land Animal. Mole a friendly companion that will help you find Gems   and Star   hidden Beneath the Earth .
 New Sea Animal. Pearl Oyster you can find Pearls and Star  that the Oyster    might have Swallowed Up !
 New Furniture set. Celestial furniture a furniture set inspired by Witches and Starry night now being added In-game!
 Added Star . A new Currency earnable from reviews (including chat reviews), the mole, pearl oyster, and Podomoro.
 Added Clothing Color Options. YES MORE COLOR!! 
 Added Full Screen mode. You can now Enjoy the whole game Art at it Fullest. 
 Added Wall Decoration for Kitchen. No more Bland Kitchen, only Colorful Kitchen Allowed!!
 Added Podomoro, a perfect companion Tool for Productive Work!! 
 Added Manual for Not Monday Cafe in the Settings.
 Added New shop Expansion Sign at the Abandoned area – links to the Expansion UI.
 Added Green Skin tone for Staff. IK We have multiple request for green skin for demi-plant but in my mind ill always see ogre and goblin. 
 

What We Have Modified  

 Increased friend mail storage from 30 to 99.
 Some bugs are Getting Squashed. 

﻿
For Streamer 
Review command No longer needs Quotation Mark. Its actually real now no longer a myth.

If you still got the issue after updated. Let us know
